items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Heyward Sr. was in charge of the band, and he wanted to augment the band.

ctx.x: I would just like to mention something before--that's just the beginning of my first being around a band, but a very important thing I'd like to say, while I was doing the gig with Ball and the gig with Thomas it was getting around that there was some youngster in town that plays a pretty good trombone. So, Butterbeans and Susie came to town and Eddie
Heyward Sr. was in charge of the band, and he wanted to augment the band. He was going to be in the Dixie Theatre for two weeks and this is on the TOBA*circuit--
